_comment: The headlines onboarding's opening throws at the reader (docs/design/ui-language.md §6 onboarding, specified 2026-11-02): samples, not articles, because a new deployment has none yet. Each title is written for the opening and never fetched; `feed` is a name from onboarding_feeds.json, the line drawn above it, so a title is in that feed's language. Titles are distinct, and the opening never shows one twice at once, so the pool's size bounds how many headlines are on screen. Served by GET /api/onboarding/headlines whatever the sources table holds, since the opening plays on any visit with no hash.
